ai_summary: Aeroflex Industries Limited is undertaking a significant ₹202 crore capacity expansion across its SS Hose & Braiding and Liquid Cooling SFN Skid Assemblies divisions, aiming to increase production by 50-100% and enhance value-added product lines by March 2028. This substantial investment, intended to meet future demands, will be financed through a mix of internal accruals, equity, and bridge loan financing. While signaling growth, the reliance on bridge loan financing and the current 70% capacity utilization suggest a strong bet on anticipated demand, which requires close monitoring.
